description: Test suite for access control policy management in Mattermost server, including creation, retrieval, deletion, expression checking, and permission enforcement for access control policies.

methods.name: TestCreateAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Tests for creating access control policies under various user permissions and license states.

methods.name: TestGetAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Tests for retrieving access control policies with different user roles and license states.

methods.name: TestDeleteAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Tests for deleting access control policies with different user permissions and license states.

methods.name: TestCheckExpression
methods.description: Tests for checking expression validity and permissions for expression evaluation.

methods.name: TestTestExpression
methods.description: Tests for testing expressions against user data and permissions.

methods.name: TestSearchAccessControlPolicies
methods.description: Tests for searching access control policies with different user roles and license states.

methods.name: TestAssignAccessPolicy
methods.description: Tests for assigning access control policies to resources with different user permissions.

methods.name: TestUnassignAccessPolicy
methods.description: Tests for unassigning access control policies from resources with different user permissions.

methods.name: TestGetChannelsForAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Tests for retrieving channels associated with a specific access control policy.

methods.name: TestSearchChannelsForAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Tests for searching channels linked to a specific access control policy.

methods.name: TestSetActiveStatus
methods.description: Tests for setting the active status of access control policies, including permission checks and security restrictions.
